verdict.rationale: Solid components are plain functions that run once and set up their own reactive local state via signals such as createSignal and derived functions (solid-gh-9, gh-14, gh-18, gh-19). They compose through JSX, fragments, Context, Portals and Stores (gh-2, gh-11). Hands-on reports confirm this at scale: a full react-bootstrap port and a largish production product (comm-4, comm-10). Missing for 10: composition carries a documented props-reactivity pitfall, where destructuring or eager access to props loses updates and no lint catches it (comm-3, comm-16).
